instruction: Open the Footprint Editor and create a new project footprint library named "proj_fp.pretty" in the project folder. In that library, create and save a footprint named "TEST_PAD" containing at least one pad.

verification.condition: Check that the directory /home/user/Desktop/test_files/kicad_pro/test/proj_fp.pretty exists and contains a file /home/user/Desktop/test_files/kicad_pro/test/proj_fp.pretty/TEST_PAD.kicad_mod whose contents include '(footprint "TEST_PAD"'.
verification.expected_result: The footprint library folder exists and the file TEST_PAD.kicad_mod is present with the correct footprint name.
